en: The image depicts a richly decorated historic building with large arched windows and an ornate facade. The structure is labeled 'CAFÉ PUPP' and features a grand outdoor terrace adorned with tables, chairs, and distinctive umbrellas. Many people, dressed in early 20th-century attire, are socializing outside. The text at the top reads 'Karlsbad. Grand Café "Pupp".' The scene suggests a bustling café atmosphere in a popular European spa town.
